overall.verdict: A genuinely coherent, trust-forward model — green/violet semantics, dollar-per-pixel scale, bilateral frames and an honest dispute flow — but on mobile it is let down by tiny grey text, trader jargon, over-precise numbers, clipped UI and at least one identity inconsistency that would worry a careful user. It is a strong concept needing a rigorous mobile legibility and consistency pass before shipping.
priority_fixes: Fix numeric and identity inconsistencies and over-precision: account 115 vs 120, 25.500023 USDC, and the signer/runtime id mismatch between sovereignty screens — round financials to 2-4 dp and enforce one canonical id per entity
Raise minimum mobile text size and contrast on capacity lines, legends, dispute body and truncated rows (filter 'Accou', 'you in 1d', clipped FROM/TO cards) so Rosa and Priya can read at arm's length
De-jargon the money model: bps, lane, 'Depository may pull', EntityProvider, lot rounding — replace with plain language or expandable detail
Guard high-risk actions: gate 'Reveal recovery phrase' and 'Forget vault' behind auth and require hold/type confirmation on 'Dispute this account'
Make the scale and colour system self-explanatory at point of use: label faded depth/scale bars, add SELL/BUY text, and reconcile the activity header's two movement counts
